name: STAG2 cohesin complex component

function.text: STAG2 encodes cohesin subunit SA-2. Annotated molecular activities include chromatin binding. It participates in mitotic spindle assembly and sister chromatid cohesion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Mullegama-Klein-Martinez syndrome (x-linked).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Ewing sarcoma; Urothelial carcinoma; Acute myeloid leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
